dek: TruBridge sells revenue-cycle and EHR services to community hospitals. Its site is a custom Timber theme on WordPress, hosted on WP Engine, with resources, events and products as their own content types.
short: TruBridge's site, for a healthcare IT company: a custom Timber and Twig WordPress theme on WP Engine, with events, products and resources as their own content types and an admin trimmed to what editors use.

items.name: Timber
items.note: Twig templates, custom classList and SVG filters

items.name: ACF
items.note: options pages, custom post types and taxonomies kept in acf-json

items.name: JavaScript
items.note: one bundled main.js with a source map, cache-busted by file time

items.name: Alpine.js
items.note: with the Collapse plugin; header store

items.name: Editor clean-up
items.note: trimmed dashboard widgets, meta boxes, media buttons and Customizer sections

highlights.title: An admin built for the editors
highlights.text: The theme removes what editors never use: dashboard widgets, extra meta boxes, view buttons on custom types, and Customizer style sections, and adds resource columns to the list screen.

images.alt: The TruBridge homepage: "Clear the way for care" over a photo of two colleagues at a laptop
